# MaxTools

> MaxTools is a free collection of online tools that run entirely in the visitor's browser: text tools, converters, calculators, and file tools. No sign-up and no uploads to a server — everything is computed on the visitor's own device. MaxTools is part of a small family of free tool sites on this domain, alongside Dr.Building (home-improvement calculators), Dr.Budget (budgeting calculators and money guides), and Dr.Find (search and everyday tools).
